title: Runtime Analysis of Cartesian Genetic Programming on Max: A Proven Exponential Speedup
abstract: arXiv:2611.16013v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Genetic Programming (GP) is a search paradigm inspired from natural evolution for the automated discovery of expressions, functions, and computer programs. Cartesian GP (CGP) is a flavor of GP that uses a graph-based model to encode candidate programs, as contrasted to the conventional Tree-based GP (TGP). Since its inception two decades ago, CGP has predominantly been analyzed empirically, thus little is known regarding its theoretical performance guarantees. This paper analyzes CGP for the Max problem, which has been only rigorously studied for TGP with a proven expected runtime superlinear in the optimal program length $n$. We prove that the expected time for the ($1$+$1$)~CGP employing common mutation operators to evolve an equivalent optimal of the same output is polylogarithmic in $n$, specifically at most $O(\log^9{n})$. translated_title: 笛卡尔遗传编程在Max问题上的运行时间分析：一个被证明的指数级加速
translated_abstract: 遗传编程（GP）是一种受自然进化启发的搜索范式，用于自动发现表达式、函数和计算机程序。笛卡尔遗传编程（CGP）是遗传编程的一种变体，它使用基于图的模型来编码候选程序，与传统的基于树的遗传编程（TGP）形成对比。自诞生以来的二十年间，CGP主要依靠经验方式进行分析，因此人们对其理论性能保证知之甚少。本文对CGP在Max问题上的表现进行了分析，该问题此前仅针对TGP进行过严格研究，其期望运行时间被证明在最优程序长度n上是超线性的。我们证明了采用常见变异算子的(1+1) CGP演化出具有相同输出的等价最优程序的期望时间在n上是多对数级的，具体而言至多为O(log⁹n)。这一结果非常引人注目，因为它表明从TGP切换到CGP可以获得指数级的加速。
tldr: 本文首次对笛卡尔遗传编程（CGP）在Max问题上进行了严格的运行时间理论分析，证明了(1+1) CGP的期望运行时间仅为多对数级O(log⁹n)，相比树状遗传编程已被证明的超线性运行时间实现了指数级加速。
en_tdlr: This paper provides the first rigorous runtime analysis of Cartesian Genetic Programming (CGP) on the Max problem, proving that (1+1) CGP achieves an expected runtime of polylogarithmic O(log⁹n), demonstrating a proven exponential speedup over the superlinear runtime established for Tree-based GP.
